name: Meera Shah (fictional test profile)
summary: MBA (Marketing) with one year running paid and lifecycle campaigns for a D2C brand.

bullets.text: Ran Meta and Google Ads campaigns with a monthly budget of Rs 8 lakh, lowering cost per order from Rs 410 to Rs 310 over 5 months
Wrote and tested 12 email and WhatsApp flows for repeat buyers; the win-back flow brought back about 900 lapsed customers
Built weekly Excel reports on channel ROI for the founders

bullets.text: Surveyed 300 gym-goers in Mumbai and recommended a Rs 199 starter plan, which the client piloted
